name: Root-Avoiding Three-Vertex Path
definition: Take the path $\{00,10,11\}$ and distinguish the endpoint $00$ as its root.
properties: Removing the peripheral side $\{11\}$ and then the remaining nonroot endpoint gives a root-avoiding peripheral decomposition. Attaching another partial cube at the root preserves these peripheral deletions, while attaching at a removed endpoint can enlarge the deleted side and destroy peripherality.
